title: Restricted integration transposes agree in geometric affine diagonal coordinates
statement: In the finite setting with Y separated finite type over k and ell^(r+1) annihilating the coefficient ring, let X, W, p1, s be the ordered affine diagonal pair. For every normalized Rees comparison q and isomorphisms J,Q whose hom maps are the actual presented integration transposes on W→X in y coordinates and on the actual normal cone→X in homogeneous coordinates [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions], the diagonal restriction of J, precomposed with inverse Tate restriction and followed by the geometric source section coordinates, equals the zero restriction of Q, precomposed with inverse Tate restriction and followed by the geometric normal section coordinates [def-pur-affine-diagonal-section-coordinates]. This is an ordinary-etale equation that does not mention a DNC arrow or family trivialization.

source.place: Agreement on the model: integration transpose, diagonal restriction and normalized standard-pair DNC

proof.text: Translation of the y-coordinate trivial bundle by minus the tautological x-vector preserves the actual normalized affine integration by the affine translation trace theorem. Transpose this equality using the exceptional Hom bijection and its counit mate. Restriction along the diagonal, which is zero in the translated coordinates, gives the standard zero restriction through the geometric source comparison.

The normal coordinate map is an isomorphism over X preserving zero. The formula for the presented transpose, functoriality of derived pullback and exceptional-mate pasting identify its zero restriction through the geometric normal comparison with the same standard zero restriction. Canonical Tate pullbacks identify the inputs. Equality of hom maps implies equality of the isomorphisms. Rank zero is the identity tower; the empty base has the same functorial identities.

theorem affineDiagonalRestrictedTransposes (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (d r : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0) :
    let p := affineDiagonalProjection Y d
    let X := affineDiagonalSpace Y d
    let W := pullback p p
    let p₁ := pullback.fst p p
    let s := pullback.diagonal p
    let aX := p ≫ aY
    letI := affineDiagonalProjection_smooth Y d
    letI := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth d p
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P p aY
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P p₁ aX
    let L := Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient P.Coefficient
      (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) hA
    let F := fun {U B : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ B) ↦
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f).leftDerivedFunctor
    ∀ (q : s.ker.normalCone ≅ PurityNormalBundle.normalCone s)
      (hq : Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.ReesConeNormalized s q),
      let πN := Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj p₁ s
      let z := s.normalConeZeroSection
      letI := Dnc.normalQuasiCompact d p₁ s (pullback.diagonal_fst p)
      letI := Dnc.normalCompactifiable P d p₁ aX s (pullback.diagonal_fst p)
      letI := (affineDiagonalNormalCoordinates_spec Y d q hq).1
      letI := (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates_spec Y d).1
      ∀ (J : L W d ≅ Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) p₁)
        (Q : L s.ker.normalCone d ≅
          Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) πN),
        J.hom = P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d p₁ aX r hA
          (asIso (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates Y d))
          (affineDiagonalProductCoordinates_spec Y d).2 →
        Q.hom = P.affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose d πN aX r hA
          (asIso (affineDiagonalNormalCoordinates Y d q))
          (affineDiagonalNormalCoordinates_spec Y d q hq).2 →
        ((P.affineDiagonalTateRestriction r hA s (p₁ ≫ aX) d).symm ≪≫
          (F s).mapIso J) ≪≫ P.affineDiagonalSourceCoordinates Y aY d =
        ((P.affineDiagonalTateRestriction r hA z (πN ≫ aX) d).symm ≪≫
          (F z).mapIso Q) ≪≫ P.affineDiagonalNormalSectionCoordinates Y aY d q hq
